findings.fix: Both parts. (1) evalNode's touch branch checks that T lies on C's carrier: |f(T)| / |grad f(T)| <= 1e-12 S (S: |T|, |P|, |P - T|, C's centre + radius or anchor). Off it, K is undefined with the new reason 'offCurve' ('The touching point is not on {c}'), so no tch is attached and no false touching meet is reported; this also covers crafted saves. (2) onCurveByRefs never counts a rectangle's corner as on a side (the corner-to-side map changes under handle drags), so a rectangle corner is P, not T.

findings.fix: Decimal pencil rule in perpForm, from the decimals C was drawn with (perpForm takes C's piece as a 4th argument; evalNode, the preview and the creation pass it). Circle C (c, r): orientD(c, P, Q) = 0 and (P - c).(Q - c) = r^2 exactly in the 12-digit decimals -> {undef: 'pencil'}. Line C through a, b: (Q - P).(b - a) = 0 and the midpoint of P Q on the line, exactly in the decimals -> 'pencil'. One configuration now gives one outcome, the pencil, as for the binary-exact 0.5 and 2.

findings.open: verify-1 (low, not fixed in v16.3): on a circle C that is not stored as decimals (a 3-point circle such as the one through 0, 1, i), a binary-exact mirror pair gives the pencil and a decimal mirror pair gives the line through the centre. Decimal circles, lines and the real axis give the pencil.

findings.fix: Decimal line rule for a line C: when (Q - P).(b - a) = 0 in the decimals of C's two points (and not a mirror pair), K is the line P Q (A = 0, B = sn J(Q - P) / |Q - P|, sn from the rounded form, as the circle rule). The creation flip then follows the left-of-P->Q rule, the far meet is infinity, and the row and caption say line or half-plane.
findings.evidence: t_constr E: the 132-case grid of t3.js (y = 2x): 130 lines, each the half-plane left of P -> Q with the far meet at infinity, and 2 mirror pairs (the pencil); 0 circles.

findings.fix: New Constr.setFlip(state, id, flip): sets def.flip and swaps index 0 <-> 1 of every meet on that shape (not seeded, not 'finite'). Flipping K's form reverses the entering rule, so the swap keeps every meet point where it was. app.js setDef routes 'flip' through it, so Use complement (row menu, Inspector, palette) is one undo step. Applies to circle3 as well as perp and touch.
findings.evidence: t_constr E: 'Use complement (setFlip) keeps the meet points on K where they are'; 'the same for a 3-point circle; setting the same flip again swaps nothing'. fix163_cmd: in the app the meet on K stays (index 0 -> 1) and one Cmd+Z brings back both.

findings.fix: Root cause: each pointermove of a glider called setDef with structural = true, which rebuilt the whole shape list (buildShapeList) and recomputed twice. Now a live setDef is not structural (rows are updated, rebuilt only on a kind or undefined change) and recomputes once; and the glider's drag stores its target in the handler and applies it in the next frame (moveUp applies a pending one at the release, before the undo step).
